timeout_preservation: Every scientific child retains its original 60-second bound. Outer 75 seconds covers orchestration without extending it.
comparison: Complete result_raw/stdout/stderr exact, except one source-declared JSON candidate path token relocated to resolved temporary candidate.py. Original bytes untouched. No environment/version/value/diagnostic mapping.
raw_api_order: Complete INNER execute_runner raw object saved first before outer identity checks; complete OUTER tuple saved first before inspection. Opaque pickle plus full readable JSON; never unpickle.
full_capture_limit: Official cache keeps its configured tail only. All complete raw API objects, live log, source-bound envelopes and original/observed calculations are saved before any comparison and archived separately.
cache_input_order: Reconstruction before/after vocabulary --fix; checked report-only; frozen EVIDENCE_MAP, PUBLICATION_EDITS, RUNTIME, all whole sources, note and formal/README fields finalized before canonical. Late maps and SOURCE_IDENTITIES are excluded from declared inputs.
graph_rule: All prior complete node records/edges remain unchanged; exactly three explicit direct premises.
lean: Preserve original successful source/object, all five attempts and all available full receipts/diagnostics; never compile, install or fetch.
audit_boundary: Exact-base focused compatibility only; combined validation and strict audit lint are separate independent landing gates. No audit application, retained promotion or Git/PR/prompt mutation.
failure_rule: Unique attempt, preserve all partial outputs and stop. No automatic retries or old science reruns; any recovery must reuse validated completed executions and preserve failures.
ownership: Root alone executes and later stages/commits/pushes/publishes. Preparation owns only this new S script/support directory.
pairing: Same selected model family and reasoning effort, separate author/reviewer contexts with candidate formulas exposed; not blinded or diverse-family. Root supplied the route and is a coauthor. The Lean formalization is root-authored scoped kernel checking, not independent reconstruction of the surrounding physics. Mechanical packaging adds no scientific review.
